# pmon_workload_bindings (Data Source)

Every workload binding: which workload tokens map to which service principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pmon_workload_bindings" "all" {}

output "service_principals" {
  value = distinct([for b in data.pmon_workload_bindings.all.bindings : b.principal])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bindings` (Attributes List) The bindings, as pmon reports them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bindings))

<a id="nestedatt--bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bindings`

Read-Only:

- `conditions` (Map of Set of String) Claims that must also hold.
- `description` (String) What the workload is.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the binding matches tokens.
- `id` (Number) pmon's internal id.
- `issuer` (String) Trusted issuer name.
- `mcp_scopes` (Set of String) The most an `mcp` exchange may carry.
- `name` (String) Binding name.
- `principal` (String) Service principal the token acts as.
- `purposes` (Set of String) What an exchange may mint.
- `subject` (String) Exact `sub`, or a prefix ending in `*`.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of a minted token.
